articles.title: Biocytogen Collaborates with Whitehawk Therapeutics to Develop Bispecific ADC
articles.text:
Skip to content Skip to footer NEWS Biocytogen Collaborates with Whitehawk Therapeutics to Develop Bispecific ADC By Ridhi Rastogi 2 days ago Shots: Biocytogen has entered into a global collaboration with Whitehawk Therapeutics to develop bispecific antibody-drug conjugates (BsADCs) Biocytogen will provide ~5 bispecific antibodies from its RenLite platform & Whitehawk will evaluate these in combination with its ADC linker-payload technologies, with Whitehawk holding the option to advance resulting BsADC candidates Biocytogen will receive an upfront payment, development, regulatory, & commercial milestones, plus low single-digit royalties, while Whitehawk may obtain global rights & full program control upon exercising its option to advance BsADC candidates Ref: Businesswire  | Image: Biocytogen & Whitehawk  | Press Release Related News: Biocytogen and Sihuan Pharmaceutical Partner to Discover Novel Therapeutics in Multiple Indications PharmaShots, your go-to media platform for customized news ranging across multiple indications. Shots:
Biocytogen has entered into a global collaboration with Whitehawk Therapeutics to develop bispecific antibody-drug conjugates (BsADCs) Biocytogen will provide ~5 bispecific antibodies from its RenLite platform & Whitehawk will evaluate these in combination with its ADC linker-payload technologies, with Whitehawk holding the option to advance resulting BsADC candidates Biocytogen will receive an upfront payment, development, regulatory, & commercial milestones, plus low single-digit royalties, while Whitehawk may obtain global rights & full program control upon exercising its option to advance BsADC candidates
Biocytogen has entered into a global collaboration with Whitehawk Therapeutics to develop bispecific antibody-drug conjugates (BsADCs)
Biocytogen
Biocytogen will provide ~5 bispecific antibodies from its RenLite platform & Whitehawk will evaluate these in combination with its ADC linker-payload technologies, with Whitehawk holding the option to advance resulting BsADC candidates
Biocytogen will receive an upfront payment, development, regulatory, & commercial milestones, plus low single-digit royalties, while Whitehawk may obtain global rights & full program control upon exercising its option to advance BsADC candidates
Ref: Businesswire  | Image: Biocytogen & Whitehawk  | Press Release
